recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Echoes of the Triforge: Relic Grove**, a portrait-first browser canvas action game faithful to the source mechanics but presented as a Zelda-like mythic RPG survival quest. The player is a green-clad relic hero controlled by touch/drag movement. An orbiting moonblade automatically strikes monsters. Edge-spawned shadow creatures pursue the hero, including chasers, erratic fliers, tanks, and projectile casters. Defeated monsters award ancient rupees, may drop relic upgrades, raise shrine level every 10 kills, and awaken the Shadow Relic Warden after 30 kills. Preserve HP failure, boss victory, restart, score, and upgrade semantics. Use procedural fantasy art, Cinzel/Rajdhani typography, grove/dungeon rune backgrounds, readable portrait HUD, and catalog-backed forest fantasy audio.

Primary steering prompt: Zelda RPG adventure. A Zelda RPG adventure game with mythic overworld exploration, puzzle dungeons, item-gated progression, hidden secrets, heroic questing, environmental puzzle-solving, boss encounters, and a legendary fantasy tone with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint: Echoes of the Triforge

## Source truth
The preserved source (`index_old.html`) is a mobile top-down canvas survival action game: press/touch start, drag on the playfield to move the hero, enemies spawn from screen edges every 1200ms, an orbiting sword damages enemies, defeated enemies add score and may drop upgrades, every 10 kills increases level, after 30 kills a boss spawns, hero HP reaching 0 causes failure, and defeating the boss causes victory.

## Protected mechanics
- Touch/mouse drag-to-move input on the canvas.
- Continuous requestAnimationFrame loop and edge enemy spawning cadence.
- Orbiting melee weapon collision radius and automatic attacks.
- Enemy archetypes: chaser, erratic, tank, shooter projectile enemy.
- Loot upgrades: damage, speed, defense, healing.
- Score from defeated enemies, level from kill milestones, boss at 30 kills.
- HP depletion failure, boss defeat victory, restart paths.

## Remix target
Zelda RPG adventure. A Zelda RPG adventure game with mythic overworld exploration, puzzle dungeons, item-gated progression, hidden secrets, heroic questing, environmental puzzle-solving, boss encounters, and a legendary fantasy tone with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

The rebuild reinterprets the source as a mythic relic grove quest. The courier/arena presentation becomes a green-clad hero with an orbiting moonblade, ancient rupees, shrine levels, relic drops, shadow monsters, and a sealed dungeon boss. Mechanics stay intact; presentation, HUD vocabulary, procedural art, background, typography, and audio mood are transformed.
